title_cyr: Немој ме, мила мамо, луто да колнеш
title_latin: Nemoj me, mila mamo, luto da kolneš
title_en: Don't curse me bitterly, dear mother
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Колниш' in line 1 is a dialect form of 'колнеш'. 'Благино село' read as 'Blaga's village'. The last stanza is a violent threat; translated literally.

lines.cyr: Немој ме, мила мамо, луто да колниш,
lines.lat: Nemoj me, mila mamo, luto da kolniš,
lines.en: Don't, dear mother, curse me bitterly,

lines.cyr: дека сум станал, мамо, младо спаивче.
lines.lat: deka sum stanal, mamo, mlado spaivče.
lines.en: for I have become, mother, a young spahi.

lines.cyr: Ај, спремај ми го, мамо, брзото коњче,
lines.lat: Aj, spremaj mi go, mamo, brzoto konjče,
lines.en: Hey, get ready for me, mother, the swift horse,

lines.cyr: јас ќе си одам, мамо, благино село.
lines.lat: jas ḱe si odam, mamo, blagino selo.
lines.en: I will go, mother, to Blaga's village.

lines.cyr: Ако е Блага, мамо, болна легнала,
lines.lat: Ako e Blaga, mamo, bolna legnala,
lines.en: If Blaga, mother, has fallen ill,

lines.cyr: јас ќе ѝ бидам, мамо, младо докторче
lines.lat: jas ḱe ì bidam, mamo, mlado doktorče
lines.en: I will be, mother, a young doctor

lines.cyr: и ќе ја лечам мамо, без пари.
lines.lat: i ḱe ja lečam mamo, bez pari.
lines.en: and I will treat her, mother, without pay.

lines.cyr: Ако е Блага, мамо, за друг свршена,
lines.lat: Ako e Blaga, mamo, za drug svršena,
lines.en: If Blaga, mother, is promised to another,

lines.cyr: јас ќе се сторам мамо, младо касапче,
lines.lat: jas ḱe se storam mamo, mlado kasapče,
lines.en: I will turn myself, mother, into a young butcher,

lines.cyr: и ќе ја сечам, мамо, парче по парче.
lines.lat: i ḱe ja sečam, mamo, parče po parče.
lines.en: and I will cut her up, mother, piece by piece.
